tay: FYI starting a quick admin entitlement spotcheck tomorrow focused on KMS grants and stale admins. Target scope: roles with >=1 KMS grant or no owner in 90d. cc @priya @evan

priya: Good call. Found one odd grant - svcacct `reporting-batch` has decrypt in prod-account-2. Can someone check cross-account intent?

evan: I'll take that. Quick checks I run: 
`aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/prod-reporting --region us-west-2` 
`aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/xyz --start-time 2025-01-01`

infra-bot: infra-bot: Created ticket RW-SEC-1102 for spotcheck and attached playbook.

priya: Plan: dry-run tagging on Mon 08:00 PT, owner notifications 24h later, removals staggered 48h windows. Add a CI/infra precheck so we don't break deploys.

tay: Agree. Add exclusion for credentials created in last 30d to avoid onboarding fallout.

evan: Update: reporting-batch decrypt calls seen from two EC2 instances in acc-A. Looks intentional but policy is wide. I'll tighten grant to specific roles and document rollback.

sec-bot: Security-bot: Remember to upload snapshots (key policy + grants + sample logs) to s3://redwood-sec-evidence/spotcheck-2026 and include sha256.

priya: Action items: evan -> tighten/reporting-key grants + push snapshots; tay -> owner email template + schedule; priya -> run dry-run and post results.

infra-bot: Scheduled dry-run job `entitlement-spotcheck --dry-run --label=spot-20260301` for Mon 08:00 PT.
